actual_transition_found.current_capability: DELTA can complete sustained objectives, preserve explicit campaign state, revise hypotheses, survive restart, and choose successor focuses.
actual_transition_found.current_storage: Completed experience is preserved as campaign evidence, active cognitive episode state, model ledgers, reports, useful artifacts, and next-focus records.
actual_transition_found.missing_transition: No proven runtime transition metabolizes completed experience into bounded reusable continuity state, retrieves it under relevance controls, and demonstrates changed behavior on a later related but non-identical objective.
actual_transition_found.consequence: DELTA has durable history, but has not yet proven it is behaviorally shaped by history.
